Frequency once per encounter

Area 10-foot burst within range

Rather than targeting one creature, a Verse you cast affects every creature in a 10-foot burst. Each attempts its own saving throw against the Verse separately. The Verse costs 1 additional Miasma, and if that draw takes you past your pool the Choir takes its toll as usual. Verses that do not target creatures are unaffected by this feat.
